Cancellation and refund policy

ArchJobs · archjobs.adityapstakuli.com · Last updated 22 November 2026

This policy covers payments for ArchJobs Pro, run by Velocity Technologies, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Everything else in ArchJobs is free.

What you buy

ArchJobs Pro is a digital service: ₹199 for 30 days or ₹1,499 for 365 days, paid once through Razorpay. It removes the weekly limits on the AI tools for the period you paid for. It does not renew automatically.

Delivery

Nothing is shipped. Pro turns on in your account as soon as the payment succeeds, usually within a few seconds and always within a few minutes. You can see it in Settings > Plan. If you paid and Pro is not on after 30 minutes, write to us with your payment ID and we will turn it on or refund you.

Cancellation

There is no subscription to cancel: you are charged only when you choose to buy, and Pro simply ends when its period is over. You can stop using Pro at any time.

Refunds

  • Within 7 days of payment, you can ask for a full refund for any reason. Write to adityatakuli51@gmail.com from the email of your ArchJobs account with your payment ID (in the Razorpay receipt email).
  • Charged twice, or charged but Pro did not turn on: you get the extra or failed payment back in full, whenever you report it.
  • After 7 days, payments are not refundable, except where the law requires it or where we stop offering ArchJobs (then the unused part is refunded).
  • An account closed for misuse under the terms is not refunded.

How refunds are paid

Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method (UPI, card or bank account) through Razorpay within 2 working days of approval. Your bank or card issuer usually shows the money within 5 to 7 working days after that. Pro ends when the refund is made.

Contact

Payment questions: adityatakuli51@gmail.com. We reply within 2 working days. See also the contact page.
